description: This file defines a class for configuring and working with Fireworks AI embedding models, including functions to support OpenAI-compatible parameters and identify Fireworks embedding models.

classes.name: FireworksAIEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for managing Fireworks AI embedding models, supporting parameter mapping and model identification.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for a given model, specifically supporting 'dimensions' for certain models.

methods.name: map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Maps non-default OpenAI-compatible parameters into the optional_params dictionary if supported by the model.

methods.name: is_fireworks_embedding_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a given model name corresponds to a known Fireworks AI embedding model based on a predefined list.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str )
